s1.title: 1. Purpose and nature of the site
s1.p1: MIZAN is an online platform connecting clients with verified legal and accounting experts in Algeria: lawyers, notaries, bailiffs and accountants. The platform facilitates search, consultation and communication between parties, without substituting for professionals in the practice of their profession.
s1.boxP1: Important: MIZAN is not the official roll of the Bar Association as provided for by Law No. 13-07 of July 29, 2013. MIZAN does not claim to replace the official registers of Algerian professional orders (bar, chamber of notaries, order of bailiffs, ONEC/ONCA).
s1.boxP2: The information published on MIZAN constitutes a complementary directory service and cannot have the same legal value as official registers.

s2.title: 2. Acceptance of terms
s2.p1: Using MIZAN implies full acceptance of these terms of use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the platform.

s3.title: 3. Registration and user account
clients: You must provide accurate and up-to-date information
You are responsible for the confidentiality of your password
pros: You must legally practice your profession in Algeria
You must provide documents proving your professional status (bar number, chamber of notaries, bailiff number or ONEC/ONCA accreditation)
Your profile will be verified before activation
You agree to comply with the ethics and rules of your profession

s4.title: 4. Services offered
items: Search for professionals by area of practice and wilaya
Publication of client reviews (subject to moderation)

s5.title: 5. Nature and origin of published information
s5.p1: The contact details and information of professionals published on MIZAN come from two sources:
s5.aTitle: A. Professionals registered on the platform
s5.aP: Professionals who create an account on MIZAN voluntarily provide their information and have full control over their profile.
s5.bP: Some information comes from public sources freely accessible on the internet: official firm websites, Google My Business, LinkedIn, public professional directories.
s5.infoP: MIZAN undertakes to inform each professional whose contact details are published, by email or phone.

s6.title: 6. Professionals' rights regarding their data
s6.p1: Every professional listed on MIZAN has the following rights, which they can exercise at any time, free of charge and without justification:
s6.rectifP: Any professional may request correction of their information if it is inaccurate or outdated.
s6.deleteP: Any professional may request the immediate and complete removal of their contact details from the site, without justification.
s6.opposeP: Any professional may object to the use of their data for matchmaking purposes.
s6.accessP: Any professional may view all information published about them on MIZAN.

s7.title: 7. Accuracy and updates
items: Areas of practice may be updated
s7.p1: Users are invited to verify directly with the relevant professionals any critical information before undertaking a legal or accounting procedure.

s8.title: 8. Responsibilities
commit: Verify the qualifications and official registration of professionals
Maintain the platform in good working order
Promptly process rectification or deletion requests
Inform professionals of the publication of their data
decline: The quality of services provided by professionals
Legal, notarial or accounting advice given
s8.importantP: Important: The site acts solely as a matchmaking intermediary. MIZAN does not select, recommend or evaluate professionals. Each user is responsible for their choice of professional.

s9.title: 9. Use of the site
items: Use the site fairly and in accordance with its purpose
Not attempt to massively extract data from the site (scraping)
Not use professionals' contact details for spam or harassment purposes
Not publish false or defamatory reviews

s10.title: 10. Intellectual property
s10.p1: All elements of the platform (logo, design, editorial content) are the exclusive property of MIZAN. Any reproduction, even partial, is strictly prohibited without prior authorization.

s11.title: 11. Modification and termination
s11.p1: MIZAN reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed by email of significant changes. You may delete your account at any time from settings.

s12.title: 12. Applicable law and jurisdiction
s12.p1: These terms are governed by Algerian law. In the event of a dispute, only Algerian courts shall have jurisdiction.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: MIZAN is committed to protecting the confidentiality and security of your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.
s1.p2: MIZAN strives to comply with Algerian legislation on personal data protection, in particular Law No. 18-07 of June 10, 2018 on the protection of individuals in the processing of personal data.

s2.title: 2. Public professional data (external source)
s2.p1: MIZAN collects and publishes professional information concerning lawyers, notaries, bailiffs and accountants practicing in Algeria. This information comes exclusively from public sources freely accessible on the internet, in particular:
sources: Official websites of law firms and notarial offices
Public professional pages (Google My Business, LinkedIn, etc.)
nature: Professional number (bar, chamber of notaries, bailiff, ONEC/ONCA if available)
s2.useP: This data is used solely within the framework of a professional directory and matchmaking service between clients and professionals. It is not subject to any unauthorized commercial exploitation.
s2.infoP: MIZAN undertakes to inform each professional whose contact details are published on the site. Professionals are contacted by email or phone to inform them of the presence of their information on the platform.
s2.rightsP: Every professional listed on MIZAN has the following rights, which they can exercise at any time and free of charge:
s2.rightRectif: Right to rectification: Correct any incorrect or outdated information
s2.rightDelete: Right to deletion: Request complete removal of their profile from the site
s2.rightOppose: Right to object: Object to the use of their data for matchmaking purposes
s2.rightAccess: Right of access: View all data published about them
s2.note: Important note: Professionals who create an account on MIZAN and claim their profile benefit from full control over their information and can edit it directly from their personal space.

s3.title: 3. Data collected for registered users
s3.prosTitle: For registered professionals (lawyers, notaries, bailiffs, accountants):
pros: Professional number (bar / chamber of notaries / bailiff / ONEC-ONCA)

s4.title: 4. Use of data
s4.p1: Your data is used solely to:
items: Facilitate matchmaking between clients and professionals
Verify the identity and qualifications of registered professionals
s4.neverSell: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

s5.title: 5. Data sharing
s5.betweenP: Clients see public information from professional profiles. Professionals see the name and email of clients who contact them.
s5.providersP: We use certified hosting providers for secure data storage.
s5.legalP: In the event of a legal judicial or administrative request.

s7.title: 7. Cookies
s7.p1: The MIZAN site uses essential cookies for its operation (authentication, preferences). We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

s9.title: 9. Data retention
s9.activeP: Data retained as long as the account exists
s9.deletedP: Data erased within 30 days, except for legal obligations
s9.reviewsP: Retained in anonymized form after account deletion
s9.unregisteredP: Retained until the professional requests its deletion

s10.title: 10. Modifications
s10.p1: We may modify this policy. Significant changes will be notified to you by email.
